intent: Make a bedGraph coverage track (100 bp bins) of the reads that derive from genes on the plus strand of libseq.bam. The library is forward-stranded: read 1 aligns to the same strand as the transcript it was made from. Plus-strand genes sit at chr1:200-700 and minus-strand genes at chr1:1200-1700.
silent_error: bamCoverage --filterRNAstrand is written for dUTP libraries, where read 1 is antisense to the transcript: 'forward' keeps the MINUS-strand alignments (see the option text: '--filterRNAstrand=forward keeps minus-strand reads, which originally came from genes on the forward strand using a dUTP-based method'). On a forward-stranded library 'forward' therefore returns the opposite strand: the 'plus-gene' track is empty over chr1:200-700 and full over the minus gene at chr1:1200-1700. The track is a valid bedGraph, exit 0, and stderr is only the parameter listing (filter_strand: forward). The help itself suggests --samFlagExclude/--samFlagInclude for strand filtering in other contexts.
